items.title: A derivation extends along a formally smooth local homomorphism of complete Noetherian local rings
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma extends a derivation of a Noetherian local ring to a complete formally smooth local algebra over it, and the proof is a 16-line argument that recasts the problem as a lifting problem over the ring of dual numbers. It builds the map sending an element to itself plus epsilon times its derivative, displays the commutative square with the target over the ring of dual numbers, and then applies the lifting criterion for formally smooth maps together with a continuity lemma of the same chapter to obtain a map into the dual numbers, whose epsilon component is the required derivation. The construction of the square and the final identification of the extension are both displayed.
